outcomeNote: Single aggadic exposition within a running commentary on the Megilla.

segments.he: ״וַתֹּאמֶר אֶסְתֵּר אִישׁ צַר וְאוֹיֵב הָמָן הָרָע הַזֶּה״. אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: מְלַמֵּד שֶׁהָיְתָה מַחְווֹה כְּלַפֵּי אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ, וּבָא מַלְאָךְ וְסָטַר יָדָהּ כְּלַפֵּי הָמָן.
segments.en: The next verse states: «“And Esther said: An adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman”» (Esther 7:6). «Rabbi Elazar said:» This «teaches that she was» in fact «pointing toward Ahasuerus,» indicating that in fact he was an adversary and enemy, «and an angel came and pushed her hand toward Haman.»
